title: FHIR R4 Encounter — platform ingestion schema
description: Starter JSON Schema for the platform's Encounter ingestion payload. This is not the official HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter schema or a profile validator. Additional FHIR elements are permitted.

id.description: Required by the platform ingestion endpoint; used as the unique persisted resource identifier.

class.description: FHIR Coding; omission is a warning, but its structure is not inspected by the runtime validator.

subject.description: Optional; if supplied and non-null, must contain a string reference.

period.description: FHIR Period; not currently inspected by the runtime validator.
